ena.Title: Functionally annotating regulatory elements in the equine genome using histone mark ChIP-Seq
ena.Description: We used Chromatin Immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-Seq) to map four histone modifications (H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K27ac, and H3K27me3) in eight prioritized tissues collected for the Equine Biobank from two Thoroughbred mares. Data were generated according to optimized experimental parameters developed during quality control testing. This file contains reads that have been aligned, trimmed, filtered, sorted, and deduplicated.
